functional_quality_policy.population: 20 historical repositories with equal weight, separately for stock, Develop and the actual merged change
functional_quality_policy.functional_mean: Sum each functional, ready proposal’s observed blinded full-PR score out of 100 and divide by 20. An observed absent or incomplete PR, an empty patch, a failed mandatory executable behavior check or a confirmed critical defect contributes zero. Preserve native scores unchanged.
functional_quality_policy.missing_measurement: When a submitted PR lacks decisive functionality or valid judge evidence, retain unknown and show the possible all-20 mean interval. Do not substitute zero for a missing measurement.
functional_quality_policy.scored_pr_mean: Also report the ordinary mean of available complete blinded full-PR scores and its denominator, including scored failures.
functional_quality_policy.precision: Calculate with unrounded full values. Three accepted rotations and the frozen aggregate axis medians determine each displayed full-PR score.
functional_quality_policy.native_status: The additional functionality-weighted descriptive metric does not modify any native gate, adjudication, price, pairwise decision or confirmation criterion.

registered_plan.purpose: Complete one current comparison across the 20 historical repositories after the optimization goal was paused. Fit no additional treatment.

second.name: iterate-entry-historical-rest-01
second.start_after: First plan has closed all 24 proposal allocations and 36 assessments. Run the same native historical cohort and package with 3 lanes.

registered_plan.coverage: Two disjoint historical splits with independent plan and qualification receipts. Every repository in the historical panel gets one stock allocation, one Develop allocation and three blinded rotations against the actual merge. Preserve every attempt and flag unmeasured outcomes. Previously exposed tasks only.
registered_plan.comparison: Require the same task/base/merge, executable fixtures, rubric, participant and assessor settings, treatment and seeded arm order across both plans. Publish the plan hashes and report setup, the operators’ elapsed times, per-proposal tokens, complete Standard cost, checkout and through-grading wall time. Keep qualification and assessor cost separate.
registered_plan.decision: Report progress and stop after the full historical benchmark. A ready Develop PR with a strict blind win and complete cost at or below stock is a joint win. State uncertain outcomes separately. Historical results do not establish fresh promotion.
